requirement_text: insurance and reinsurance companies are required to implement management systems that will assure correct and prudent management of the business in consideration of its nature, scale and complexity.
mandatory_action: Insurance and reinsurance companies must implement management systems for prudent business management.

requirement_text: Insurance and reinsurance companies are required to maintain written rules of risk management, internal controls, internal audits and outsourcing, to be reviewed annually, mainly in the framework of new risks identified by insurers that may affect their adequate financial standing.
mandatory_action: Insurance and reinsurance companies must maintain and annually review written rules of risk management, internal controls, internal audits, and outsourcing.

requirement_text: they should be subject to regular internal reviews every year as a minimum
mandatory_action: Conduct regular internal reviews of the control mechanisms at least annually.

requirement_text: they should be approved by an administrative, management or supervisory authority
mandatory_action: Obtain approval of the control mechanisms from the relevant authority.

requirement_text: a control system should be verified by a supervisory authority with regard to risks identified by the insurer that may affect adequate financial standing
mandatory_action: Ensure the control system is verified by a supervisory authority for risk assessment.

requirement_text: a control system should be verified by a supervisory authority with regard to risks identified by the insurer that may affect adequate financial standing
mandatory_action: A control system must be verified by a supervisory authority regarding identified risks.

requirement_text: a supervisory authority should have the right to require improvement and strengthening of the management system
mandatory_action: A supervisory authority must have the right to mandate improvements to the management system.

requirement_text: rules of risk management, internal audit, internal control and outsourcing should be executed in writing
mandatory_action: Rules of risk management, internal audit, internal control, and outsourcing must be documented in writing.

requirement_text: companies were required to establish audit committees by 6 December, 2009, i.e. within six months of the effective date of the amended Expert Auditors Act.
mandatory_action: Companies must establish audit committees by the specified deadline.

requirement_text: companies were required to establish by 6 December, 2009, i.e. within six months of the effective date of the amended Expert Auditors Act.
mandatory_action: Companies must establish an audit committee by December 6, 2009.

requirement_text: Audit committees must have a minimum of three members, including at least one independent member with accounting or financial auditing qualifications.
mandatory_action: Audit committees must consist of at least three members, including one independent member with relevant qualifications.

requirement_text: audit commissions consisting of a minimum of 3 members, including at least 1 member meeting the conditions of independence with accounting or financial auditing qualifications
mandatory_action: Audit commissions must consist of a minimum of 3 members, including at least 1 independent member with accounting or financial auditing qualifications.

requirement_text: supervisory boards comprising not more than 5 members
mandatory_action: Supervisory boards must comprise no more than 5 members.

mandatory_action: Businesses must establish audit committees and provide them with necessary tools and controls.
